svg.title: Moon base — direct 3D mesh vectorization
svg.desc: Projected directly from the game's original Three.js meshes. A supersampled geometry depth buffer resolves visible surfaces into vector paths; materials and glows use editable SVG gradients. Fictional game illustration.
